description: Source code for the LPS22HB pressure and temperature sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, including initialization, data fetching, and conversion functions.

methods.name: lps22hb_set_odr_raw
methods.description: Sets the output data rate (ODR) for the sensor.

methods.name: lps22hb_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches a sample of pressure and temperature data from the sensor.

methods.name: lps22hb_press_convert
methods.description: Converts raw pressure data to sensor_value format.

methods.name: lps22hb_temp_convert
methods.description: Converts raw temperature data to sensor_value format.

methods.name: lps22hb_channel_get
methods.description: Retrieves pressure or temperature data based on the channel.

methods.name: lps22hb_init_chip
methods.description: Initializes the sensor chip, verifies chip ID, and sets default configurations.

methods.name: lps22hb_init
methods.description: Initializes the sensor device, checks I2C bus readiness, and calls chip initialization.
